data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all package files and found no malicious code, unpinned sources, or suspicious network activity. The package downloads pinned binaries from the official upstream GitHub repository. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was solely due to API errors (HTTP 400) when processing the PKGBUILD and .gitignore, which are treated as coverage failures rather than security findings.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool/API failure in the qwen model (HTTP 400 errors on .gitignore and PKGBUILD), resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model completed the audit successfully and found no security issues.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .gitignore and PKGBUILD due to HTTP 400 API errors, leading to an inconclusive overall verdict.
learnings: Implement retry mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent transient HTTP 400 errors from causing partial audits and inconclusive package verdicts.

Decouple file-level API failures from the final package verdict; if a file fails to audit due to a tool error, it should be flagged as a coverage issue rather than forcing an 'inconclusive' security verdict when the rest of the package is clean.
